text:
Magnesium is reacted with dilute hydrochloric acid of the same concentration in four experiments
using different conditions.
Which reaction finished in the shortest time?
2g of magnesium powder in 50cm3 of dilute HCl at 45°C
A
2g of magnesium powder in 50cm3 of dilute HCl at 50°C
B
2g of magnesium ribbon in 50cm3 of dilute HCl at 45°C
C
2g of magnesium ribbon in 50cm3 of dilute HCl at 50°C
D
